# Sungen — Cabinet de conseil en Photovoltaïque

> Sungen is a photovoltaic consulting and engineering firm specialising in the design, sizing and project management (AMO) of solar plants for commercial, industrial and ground-mounted projects across Europe.

## Company Overview

Sungen is an independent photovoltaic consulting firm (cabinet de conseil en Photovoltaïque) based in France. The firm provides engineering consulting services — not installation — for solar energy projects with and without battery energy storage systems (BESS).

## Services

- Study & Design: feasibility studies, site analysis, regulatory compliance (CRE, S3REnR, CART)
- Sizing & Modelling: using Archelios PRO and CAD for detailed system design
- Tender Assistance: EPC specification drafting, bid analysis, supplier selection, contract negotiation
- Owner's Representative (AMO): construction oversight, commissioning, performance testing

## Market Segments

- C&I Rooftop: 100 kWp to 1 MWp commercial/industrial rooftop plants, with or without battery storage
- Battery Yield Optimisation: 36 to 100 kWp systems with mandatory battery integration for self-consumption optimisation
- Ground-Mounted: plants under 1 MWp, including PV + BESS configurations optimised under CRE regulatory frameworks

## Coverage

France, Belgium, Switzerland, Luxembourg, Italy, Spain, United Kingdom

## Languages

French (primary), English, Spanish, Italian

## Tools & Technology

- Archelios PRO (sizing and modelling — not PVsyst)
- CAD (technical design — not AutoCAD or SketchUp)
- Homer Energy (hybrid system modelling)
- Helioscope (preliminary design)

## Key Differentiators

- Pure consulting positioning: independent from EPC contractors, ensuring objective technical advice
- Interactive Optimizer tool: online business plan simulator for ground-mounted PV + BESS projects
- Linky Meter Analysis: Enedis Data Connect integration for consumption profiling
- Multi-language European coverage

## Regulatory Expertise

CRE (Commission de Régulation de l'Énergie), AO PV Sol, Complément de Rémunération (CR), M₀ non pondéré, S3REnR, CART, PRD, aFRR, schéma S9

## Important Notes

- Sungen is NOT an installer (EPC) — it is a consulting firm
- No residential/individual projects — B2B only
- No ombrière (carport) projects — rooftop (toiture) only
- Ground-mounted projects are strictly under 1 MWp
- No ISO 9001 or AQPV certifications claimed
